name: Student's Pass

requirements.blocker_text: This requires full-time enrolment at an approved Singapore educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to an approved institution.

evidence_required.document: Admission letter from an approved institution
Proof of financial support for tuition and living costs

notes: SOURCING CAVEAT flagged honestly: work rights during study are genuinely restricted relative to most other countries' student routes in this dataset — Singapore permits work only in narrow, specific circumstances (certain approved institutions, capped hours, and often only during vacation periods) rather than a broad general entitlement, but the exact current hours-per-week figure and which institutions qualify for term-time work was not confirmed at tier-1 precision during this research pass. No dedicated post-study job-seeking visa/permit was confirmed as currently active, similar to the honest gap flagged on jp_student — Singapore graduates seeking to stay for work must secure a job offer meeting Employment Pass or S Pass thresholds before their Student's Pass expires, rather than having a separate bridging permit. Direct feeder into sg_employment_pass and sg_s_pass once a qualifying job offer is secured.
